blurb: Guests can enjoy a diverse selection of 10 specialty beers on tap, including a new exclusive tasting room release each month. The brewery offers a variety of craft beers including Double IPAs, wheat beers, porters, lagers, and sours. Visitors can enjoy pints, flights, and participate in events such as live music, comedy shows, and trivia nights.
